title: Rendlesham/Bentwaters cover-up and interrogations
place_text: RAF Bentwaters, Rendlesham Forest, Suffolk, UK

tellings.quote: No. OSI shows up in plane. HVT escort teams show up, haul everything away. People are sworn to secrecy.

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once helped retrieve a UFO, talks about a 1980 event in Rendlesham Forest by RAF Bentwaters, an air base in Suffolk, England, citing a man he calls Lord Norton. Barber says that after it happened, the OSI, the US Air Force's investigation service, flew in, special escort teams hauled everything away, and people were questioned and sworn to secrecy. If true, it would mean the military moved quickly to bury whatever happened there.
